# llms.txt - AI/LLM Crawler Information for pyflix
# https://animeshkundu.github.io/pyflix/

name: pyflix
tagline: Python Torrent Streaming Library
description: >
  pyflix is a Python torrent streaming library that powers torrent-dl. It enables 
  sequential downloading of torrent files for video streaming, featuring MOOV atom 
  detection for optimal playback, smart download strategies, a built-in HTTP streaming 
  server, VLC player integration, and configurable settings via YAML.

repository: https://github.com/animeshkundu/pyflix
documentation: https://github.com/animeshkundu/pyflix/tree/main/docs
license: MIT
language: Python

key_features:
  - Sequential downloading for immediate video playback
  - MOOV atom detection using qtfaststart for streamability check
  - Smart download strategy with configurable piece prioritization
  - Built-in threaded HTTP server with range request support
  - VLC player integration out of the box
  - YAML-based configuration for settings, limits, and player preferences
  - Daemon mode support for background operation
  - Metadata extraction using guessit

core_modules:
  torrent/__init__.py: Download manager, session handling, streaming coordination
  torrent/strategy.py: DefaultStrategy class for piece prioritization
  torrent/moov.py: MOOV atom detection for MP4 files
  utils/streamer.py: HTTP streaming server with range request support
  utils/helpers.py: Utility functions for ports, settings, interfaces
  utils/settings.py: Configuration constants

installation:
  pip: pip install pyflix
  source: pip install git+https://github.com/animeshkundu/pyflix.git

requirements:
  - Python 3.9+
  - libtorrent with Python bindings
  - qtfaststart
  - PyYAML

basic_usage: |
  from pyflix.torrent import DownloadManager
  
  magnet = "magnet:?xt=urn:btih:..."
  manager = DownloadManager(magnet, port=8888, serve=True)
  manager.start()
  # Video available at http://localhost:8888

categories:
  - Python libraries
  - Torrent
  - Video streaming
  - Media
  - Developer tools

related_projects:
  - torrent-dl (CLI tool powered by pyflix)
  - libtorrent (underlying torrent library)
  - qtfaststart (video atom manipulation)

contact: https://github.com/animeshkundu/pyflix/issues
